_note: The daily plan for every persona (default: 3 reels a day from day 3; raise it later based on performance). The app reads this file on every request, no rebuild needed. Fixed days are listed by number; 'repeat_from' is the template for every day from that number on. 'overrides' maps a persona id to its own day list (used instead of the global one). A day a poster has already opened keeps the task list it had then; edits apply to days not opened yet. 'one_day_per_calendar_day': true = the next day opens on the next calendar day at the earliest; false = a finished day offers the next one right away, so a poster with momentum can do several days in one sitting. A 'post_reel' is one video posted on every platform in platforms.json.

behaviors: Follow the accounts from the list below
Like roughly 1 in every 3-4 posts you see
Comment on roughly 1 in every 10 posts
Watch videos all the way to the end
Search the keywords and do the same there
